entities.name: CoaBC bifunctional enzyme
observations: A 406-aa sequence is homologous to reviewed CoaBC proteins, with 40.8% identity and 96.1% query coverage to Synechocystis sp. P73881.
The sequence contains Flavoprotein PF02441 (positions 13–184) and DFP PF04127 (positions 192–401), consistent with the two-domain CoaBC architecture.
The enzyme catalyzes two sequential steps in coenzyme A biosynthesis.
The protein binds FMN and uses Mg2+ according to reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: 4-phosphopantothenate cysteine ligation
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H(+).
This is EC 6.3.2.5 and maps to Rhea RHEA:19397 in the retrieved reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: This is EC 4.1.1.36 and maps to Rhea RHEA:16793 in the retrieved reviewed homolog annotations.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC performs steps 2 and 3 of bacterial coenzyme A biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate, producing 4'-phosphopantetheine from phosphopantothenate and cysteine through the ligated intermediate.
